task_name: Floating IP - DNAT internal service with manual failover (final state on edge2)
intent: Expose an internal HTTP service using a public floating VIP and DNAT. Configure the system so that in the FINAL STATE the VIP and NAT rules are ACTIVE on edge2 (manual failover completed). Implement DNAT VIP:8080 -> 10.0.0.100:8080 and ensure return traffic works using SNAT/MASQUERADE. Provide auditable iptables rules (DNAT + SNAT + FORWARD allow). Do not break management connectivity on eth0. Do not flush/reset firewall tables. Do not modify lab IP addressing.

edge2: iptables -A FORWARD -p tcp -d 10.0.0.100 --dport 8080 -m conntrack --ctstate NEW,ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
iptables -A FORWARD -p tcp -s 10.0.0.100 --sport 8080 -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT

ground_truth_reasoning: Final state has the floating VIP and NAT active on edge2 (manual failover completed). DNAT maps VIP:8080 to 10.0.0.100:8080. FORWARD rules allow the flow. MASQUERADE on WAN egress ensures return traffic works without modifying the server routing.

testcases.name: Internal service is listening on srv:8080
Sanity: edge2 can reach the internal service directly on LAN
Service is reachable through VIP from WAN (DNAT + return traffic) via edge2 final state
Audit: edge2 has DNAT rule VIP:8080 -> 10.0.0.100:8080
Audit: edge2 has MASQUERADE for 10.0.0.0/24 out eth1

baseline_invariants.name: VIP must be present on edge2 eth1 (final state)
